sloka: अथासनात् समुत्पत्य स्रजं मणिकृतान्तराम्।आबबन्ध महातेजाः कुम्भकर्णस्य रावणः ।। ६.६५.२५ ।।
transliteration: athāsanāt samutpatya srajaṁ maṇikṛtāntarām।ābabandha mahātejāḥ kumbhakarṇasya rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.65.25 ।।

translations.english: And then the brilliant Ravana got up from his seat, garlanded Kumbhakarna with garland s of flowers encrusted with gems.
